behavior: AC1-AC3: not elevated, a machine-wide id is never attempted, a failing id is left waiting, both are named, and the probe is nil
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestSystemUpgradeWindows.*WithoutElevation' ./internal/converge/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSystemUpgradeWindowsWithoutElevationSkipsMachineWideAndToleratesAFailure'

behavior: AC4: elevated, a failing winget id fails the step and the probe names it
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestSystemUpgradeWindows(UpgradesPerIdAndIsolatesAFailure|ElevatedUpgradesMachineWide)' ./internal/converge/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSystemUpgradeWindowsUpgradesPerIdAndIsolatesAFailure'

behavior: AC5: dotf update reads a step that left ids waiting as a skip reason
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test -count=1 -v -run 'TestSystemUpgradeSkipReadsOnlyTheStepsSkip' ./internal/cmd/) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSystemUpgradeSkipReadsOnlyTheStepsSkip/ran_but_left_ids_waiting_for_elevation'

behavior: AC6: the tree vets for windows, linux and darwin
verification: cd cli && GOOS=windows go vet ./internal/converge/ ./internal/cmd/ && GOOS=linux go vet ./internal/converge/ ./internal/cmd/ && GOOS=darwin go vet ./internal/converge/ ./internal/cmd/
